title: Use personal GitHub identity for fantasy repository pushes
description:
## Context

The required push of the Full planning setup failed: git push -u origin master reported permission denied to DDC-Heartwood for DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant.git. This blocks publishing the planning state tracked by fantasy-p55, the epic for the initial product planning session.

## Steps to Reproduce

In /home/ddc/dev-environment/fantasy, origin in .git/config is git@github.com:DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant.git. Run git push -u origin master using the current github.com SSH host configuration.

## Expected Behavior

The operator-authorized personal repository accepts the planning commits using the configured personal identity.

## Actual Behavior

The github.com host in /home/ddc/.ssh/config selects ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 and authenticates as DDC-Heartwood, which lacks write access. Read-only gh auth status confirms an existing active DylanDelliColli account. The same SSH configuration defines github-personal with ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_personal.

## Approach

Use the existing github-personal SSH host for this repository's push URL, preserving the operator-supplied origin fetch URL and global account configuration. Push the committed planning state and verify remote tracking. If the personal SSH identity fails, use the existing personal GitHub CLI credential through HTTPS without printing credential values.

## File footprint

.git/config (local push URL only), .beads/issues.jsonl (tracked work state). Do not modify /home/ddc/.ssh/config or private keys.

## Test Spec

[no-test] Credential routing and tracker metadata only; no application code path. Verify with a real git push -u origin master, git status -sb reporting origin/master without ahead commits, and git ls-remote confirming the published commit. Run br lint --status all.

## Acceptance Criteria

The planning commits are pushed to DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant, the local branch tracks origin/master, and a normal repository-local push uses the authorized personal identity. Record validation and close this blocker.
close_reason: Resolved and verified: repository pushes use the existing personal SSH identity; planning commits published successfully.

comments.author: ddc
comments.text: Verified: repository-local origin push URL now uses github-personal, leaving the fetch URL and global SSH configuration unchanged. git push -u origin master succeeded; GitHub advertises planning commit 219a239 and git status reports master tracking origin/master. br lint --status all passed. [no-test]: local credential configuration only; actual remote write verified.

title: Plan draft-first Sleeper assistance for tonight
description:
## Context

The operator approved Full /abacus-plan for a new personal fantasy football assistant on Sleeper. The league is redraft and the draft is tonight, reported as approximately nine hours away on 2026-09-08. Draft assistance and rapid mid-draft consultation are the immediate priority. Recommendations only; the operator makes picks in Sleeper. Season management remains future scope. Sleeper is the only current source, and the operator welcomes additional source suggestions.

## Scope

Complete the six operator-gated stages from /home/ddc/.claude/skills/abacus-plan/SKILL.md. FRAMING approved by the operator on 2026-09-08. RESEARCH approved on 2026-09-08 by the operator: perfect. Continue on. Current stage: ARCHITECTURE deliverable ready for operator review; TEST-STRATEGY not started. PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md is the sole in-flight record, registered in docs-corpus.json. It contains confirmed constraints, proposed stable stories, non-goals, one product success metric, preliminary source checks explicitly requested by the operator, and unresolved inputs. The RESEARCH section contains verified source and integration findings, provisional new module footprints and bundle groups, and explicit operator decisions. The revised RESEARCH gate is approved; the new ARCHITECTURE section defines the proposed runtime, source and state contracts, recommendation policy, and browser flow for review. Commit each stage deliverable and obtain its approval before advancing. Use docs/adr/ for warranted durable decisions. Delete the in-flight record only at approved handoff after preserving its substance in beads and durable records.

## Stories and Proposed First Release

US-DRAFT-01: Prepare using actual league settings and position. US-DRAFT-02: Quickly see three available candidates with short grounded reasons, excluding observed draft picks and considering the operator roster. US-DRAFT-03: Display draft/data freshness and retain a clearly stale last usable board on refresh failure. US-SEASON-01: Later season-management goal, outside tonight scope. A browser shortlist beside Sleeper is approved. Approved product success metric: before the real draft, the operator selects a preferred available player within 10 seconds in each of three rehearsed turns at picks 1,28,29 using their league settings and updated draft state; include a previously recommended player taken by another manager. The shortlist should show the next two picks and update between consecutive turn selections.

## Open Questions and Prerequisites

Q3 resolved through live Sleeper reads on 2026-09-08: league 1389330057733865472 (2026 Fiji); user Kijuuu / 1264288993504149504; roster ID 5; draft 1389330057733865473; draft slot 1. 14-team half-PPR redraft; QB/2RB/2WR/TE/FLEX/K/DEF plus 4 bench and 1 reserve; 13-round snake; 60-second pick timer; scheduled 2026-09-08 21:00:45 America/New_York. First overall picks 1,28,29,56,57. No picks yet; operator roster and keepers empty. The active draft rounds=13 and roster ID=5 must not be confused with league draft_rounds=3 and draft slot=1.

Q6 browser presentation and Q8 framing signoff resolved by operator approval. Q7 source direction and Q11 research signoff were resolved by the research approval on 2026-09-08. Sleeper is primary, with optional private FantasyPros expert ranks/tiers. Q1 product intent, Q2 remote, Q4 draft first, Q5 recommendations only are resolved. External prerequisite beads: none; verified public league inputs are available. A usable current ranking source is a research outcome, not an assumed capability.

Research conclusion revised after the operator identified Sleeper ADP and player stats: use Sleeper as the primary provider for league/draft/pick state, canonical IDs, platform ADP, season projections, and historical actual stats. Ordinary unauthenticated GETs to https://api.sleeper.app/projections/nfl/2026?season_type=regular and https://api.sleeper.app/v1/projections/nfl/regular/2026 returned 9,419 rows; all top 400 mapped ECR players have half-PPR ADP below the observed 999 sentinel, and 394 have positive projected half-PPR points. https://api.sleeper.app/stats/nfl/2025?season_type=regular returned 8,248 actual-stat rows. These routes are not listed in the supplied official docs; validate schema/season/coverage and preserve usable snapshots. ADP sentinel 999 and inconsistent gp semantics require care.

A private dated FantasyPros half-PPR snapshot is proposed as supplementary expert rankings/tiers; its top 400 uniquely match active Sleeper IDs. FFC was verified as an alternative but is removed from the proposed nightly pipeline because Sleeper ADP has wider checked coverage and canonical IDs. No paid API is needed for this proposed route. Current pre-draft pick cache headers advertise 30 seconds shared freshness and 300 seconds stale-while-revalidate; live freshness is unmeasured. Recommend bounded polling, honest last-check/pick-count display, and reversible local corrections.

Architecture decisions pending: Q9 confirm the proposed local browser on this computer (or revise for hosting); Q10 confirm the concrete local taken/my-pick/undo and rollback-review behavior; Q12 architecture signoff. The local preference question is still unanswered and remains explicit in the gate. Source research child fantasy-p55.1 was reviewed, reproduced, integrated, and closed. Node v24.13.1 is available; the proposal selects plain ESM, built-in HTTP, private atomic snapshots and one session owner. No implementation or test-strategy stage has started.

The ARCHITECTURE section in PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md is the complete proposed contract. It specifies prepareData, normalized snapshot provenance, deterministic identity/eligibility checks (including a current NFL team), optional ECR with labeled ADP-only fallback, and a roster-completion-aware three-player shortlist. It defines fetchDraftSnapshot, reconcileDraft/applyLocalAction/deriveEffectiveDraft, next picks 1/28/29, five-second single-flight polling, stale and non-extension handling, and atomic persisted local actions. src/session.mjs owns revisions, persistence, refresh and BoardView; the browser renders the same calculation without duplicating domain rules. Planned module write paths are re-derived there; implementation/test files are still uncreated. Producer substitution: orchestrator inline, because gaudi epic mode requires implementation children that Full planning creates later in DECOMPOSITION. The mismatch was captured in jot. Current changes remain documentation/tracker only.

## File footprint

.beads/issues.jsonl, docs-corpus.json, PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md. Add warranted docs/adr/ paths to the bead before authoring. No application code exists.

## Test Spec

[no-test] Current changes are planning documents and tracker metadata only. Run docs-doctor --repo . --json, br lint --status all, and git diff --check. During TEST-STRATEGY, specify unit and real-composition integration assertions, estimate proposed test runtime against the 30-second full-suite budget, and measure any suite that exists then. Every eventual code child needs full write paths, concrete acceptance assertions, verification commands, and requirements-directed dependencies.

## Success Criteria

All six Full gates are approved. The backlog meets the Fresh Agent Test, covers the approved draft-only release, and has zero open questions or scope gaps. br dep tree, br ready, and br lint verify correct state. Planning/tracker state is committed and pushed to origin/master at git@github.com:DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant.git, using the existing github-personal push host. Execution is not launched implicitly.
design: ARCHITECTURE proposal at PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md: local Node 24 ESM process and plain browser; validated private Sleeper snapshot plus optional ECR with ADP-only fallback; one session owner serializing accepted pick snapshots, revisions, atomic persistence, and local actions; pure roster matching/recommendation functions; five-second non-overlapping upstream polling with backoff; immediate local own-pick updates at 28/29; explicit review for non-extension snapshots. Current-team membership tightens candidate eligibility. Exact interfaces, paths, HTTP routes, policy ordering, failure contracts, and tradeoffs are in the committed gate deliverable. Proposed only until Q9/Q10/Q12 architecture approval.
acceptance_criteria: The operator has approved the tier and all required stage gates; the resulting child beads pass the Fresh Agent Test, include requirements-directed dependencies and unit/integration test contracts, and have zero unresolved questions. Planning and tracker state are committed and pushed to the confirmed remote. Execution is not launched as part of planning.
notes: [no-test] FRAMING and RESEARCH approved. ARCHITECTURE complete for operator review; Q9 proposed local browser, Q10 concrete local corrections, and Q12 gate approval remain pending. Documentation validation passed: docs-doctor clean, br lint --status all clean for 3 issues, and git diff --check clean. No application code, implementation children, or TEST-STRATEGY work started. All current output is planning/tracker state. The architecture gate confirms the local deployment choice explicitly; silence on the earlier preference question was not treated as approval.

title: Research current draft rankings and half-PPR ADP inputs
description:
## Context

Independent source research for fantasy-p55, the approved Full planning epic for tonight's personal Sleeper draft assistant. Read the approved FRAMING section of PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md. The actual league is 14-team half-PPR redraft, 13-round snake, 60-second picks; operator drafts first (1,28,29). Deadline is 2026-09-08 about 21:00 America/New_York. Browser shortlist, source-grounded reasons, actual roster context, and freshness are approved. No implementation or purchase is authorized.

## Task

Verify an accessible current-2026 half-PPR draft ranking input and 14-team half-PPR ADP input using primary official sources and real read-only HTTP probes. Candidate sources: https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/half-point-ppr-cheatsheets.php (public rankings/export; actual import path unverified), https://www.fantasypros.com/api-data/ (free API is sample data, paid HOF production optional), https://fantasyfootballcalculator.com/adp/half-ppr and its official JSON/CSV links (prior 12-team PPR probe is not sufficient). Determine ranking coverage, update timestamp, tiers/ADP fields, import method, player identifiers/matching considerations, and limits affecting tonight. Distinguish expert value rankings from market ADP. Explore enough alternatives to propose a viable path without assuming an unprovided subscription or key; do not bypass access controls or buy anything.

## File footprint

Read PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md and the isolated worktree only. Save probe artifacts under /tmp if needed. Return a sourced prose deliverable to the parent; do not edit the root planning record or implement application files. Parent integrates findings into PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md. Tracker state is .beads/issues.jsonl.

## Acceptance Criteria

Send a concise evidence-backed recommendation with exact URLs and reproducible read-only verification commands, observed current season/scoring/coverage/freshness, paid-versus-free access facts, remaining questions, and provisional data-module footprints tied to the approved stories. Report failed probes and limitations without claiming they establish site-wide outages. No raw external datasets committed.

## Test Spec

[no-test] Read-only research and tracker metadata, no code changes. Use actual HTTP responses and schema/count/date checks to verify claims. Parent runs docs-doctor, br lint, and git diff checks after integration.
close_reason: Verified source research and identity audit integrated into the parent RESEARCH deliverable; operator research approval remains on the epic.

comments.author: ddc
comments.text:
RESEARCH COMPLETE for parent review (2026-09-08 16:33 UTC); leave bead open until parent integrates. Recommended tonight: local dated FantasyPros public half-PPR ECR snapshot for value/tiers, FFC free JSON ADP for market context, Sleeper IDs/eligibility/picks as canonical. No account, purchase, production API, or raw dataset in Git needed for this researched route.

FantasyPros: unauthenticated GET https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/half-point-ppr-cheatsheets.php succeeded. HTML contains JSON in var ecrData (parse JSON, never eval page script). Snapshot /tmp/fantasypros-half-ppr.html -> /tmp/fantasypros-ecr-data.json has 978 unique players, year 2026, week 0, scoring HALF, type Draft Half PPR, 134 experts, tiers 1–16, overall/position ranks and min/max/average/stddev ranks; no ADP fields in this snapshot. Provider last_updated_ts 1788883961 = 2026-09-08 16:12:41 UTC; accessed string 2026-09-08 16:25:24. Provider explains Latest Update is their last check for revisions; individual expert publication dates vary. Public page copy is verified; free CSV export is not verified and must not be assumed. https://www.fantasypros.com/about/legal/ section 6 permits a single personal-use copy; keep snapshot local and do not treat that as redistribution permission or a supported ingestion API. HTML parser can break; validate complete snapshot before atomic replacement and retain last usable snapshot.

Supported API alternative: https://www.fantasypros.com/api-data/ free API supplies sample data/non-production; paid HOF supplies personal production key (from $8.99/month billed annually advertised, no purchase authorized). https://support.fantasypros.com/hc/en-us/articles/49749297704475-How-do-I-request-access-to-the-FantasyPros-API says HOF trial does not grant production API. Separate Sept 1 official MCP docs https://support.fantasypros.com/hc/en-us/articles/55238312588571-What-tools-are-available-in-the-FantasyPros-MCP-Server say free-account get_ecr/get_adp are available. https://support.fantasypros.com/hc/en-us/articles/55212611981851-How-do-I-connect-to-the-FantasyPros-MCP-Server specifies OAuth at https://api.fantasypros.com/mcp, no API key. No connected FantasyPros tool/account available here, so real MCP response/import remains untested and is optional rather than a dependency tonight.

FFC: followed JSON link on official https://fantasyfootballcalculator.com/adp/half-ppr/14-team/all to https://fantasyfootballcalculator.com/api/v1/adp/half-ppr?position=all&teams=14&year=2026 . Snapshot /tmp/ffc-half-ppr-14.json returned Success, Half-PPR, teams 14, rounds 15, 1837 drafts, date range Sept 3–8 2026; 209 unique players (57 RB, 75 WR, 25 QB, 20 TE, 16 DEF, 16 PK), numeric ADP 1.5–182.4, min per-player times_drafted 5. Fields include source player_id, name, position, team, adp, adp_formatted, times_drafted, high, low, stdev, bye. Official https://help.fantasyfootballcalculator.com/article/42-adp-rest-api documents free personal/commercial use, requested attribution, daily updates (not per-pick polling). Source mock drafts are 15 rounds vs actual 13. One controlled teams=12 comparison /tmp/ffc-half-ppr-12.json found all numeric ADPs and dispersion fields identical; only 197 adp_formatted values differ. Preserve this as possible source methodology, not a proven bug: it is a 14-labelled response, but distinct 14-team calibration is not established. Do not turn ADP/stdev into survival probabilities. FFC rankings page https://fantasyfootballcalculator.com/rankings/half-ppr itself says rankings derive from ADP, so it is not an independent expert-value source.

Identity/coverage: use parent-fetched /tmp/fantasy-research-players.json only (12,226 Sleeper entries). Reproducible no-network extraction/matching script /tmp/fantasy-rankings-source-probe.py writes /tmp/fantasy-rankings-source-summary.json and /tmp/fantasypros-sleeper-match-audit-final.json plus /tmp/ffc-sleeper-match-audit-final.json. Run python /tmp/fantasy-rankings-source-probe.py. Normalizes Unicode diacritics, punctuation, suffixes, team JAC->JAX, PK->K/DST->DEF; uses Sleeper fantasy_positions (Travis Hunter is primary DB but WR eligible); unique name/position with team tie-break; explicit FantasyPros ID aliases 18226 Hollywood Brown->Marquise Brown and 24901 Bam Knight->Zonovan Knight corroborated by page filenames and Sleeper name/team/position. No fuzzy autojoin. Top 400 ECR all match unique active Sleeper entries: 110 RB, 142 WR, 59 TE, 43 QB, 25 DEF, 21 K. All 209 FFC players match uniquely and active. Full ECR 970/978 match; eight unresolved ranks >=489 are shown in audit and must be quarantined, not guessed. All 38 ECR K and 32 ECR DEF map. All top100 ECR have FFC ADP but only 178/200 top200 do: absent ADP must stay null rather than invented. This provides deep coverage for the 182-pick actual draft without claiming every possible player has a ranking.

Repro HTTP commands: curl -sS -L --fail --max-time 30 -o /tmp/fantasypros-half-ppr.html https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/half-point-ppr-cheatsheets.php ; separately curl -sS -L --fail --max-time 30 -o /tmp/ffc-half-ppr-14.json 'https://fantasyfootballcalculator.com/api/v1/adp/half-ppr?position=all&teams=14&year=2026' ; optional one-time control substitutes teams=12 and output filename. Run the Python audit after files exist. Initial default-sandbox curl DNS and jot writes failed; approved escalation succeeded, so no provider outage claim. Captured environmental limits and identity edges with jot; FFC methodology capture .git/jot/pending/20260908T163124Z-231635-868121.json.

Provisional footprints for architecture: private snapshot importer/cache and manifest (source URL, season/scoring, fetched_at, provider update/check time, counts/schema version); canonical player identity adapter with explicit reviewed aliases/quarantine; ranking/ADP composition with nullable market data; source/freshness component; pure recommendation input keyed by Sleeper ID. Tie to US-DRAFT-01 preparation/source evidence, US-DRAFT-02 eligible available candidates, US-DRAFT-03 independent ranking vs draft freshness. Proposed test files: tests/unit/rankings-import.test.*, tests/unit/player-identity.test.*, tests/integration/rankings-snapshot.test.*. Unit tests malformed/wrong-year/scoring/missing ranks/duplicate IDs and identity edge cases; real-filesystem integration imports a fixture HTML+ADP+Sleeper map through actual parser/cache composition, checks 1/28/29 candidates are mapped/unpicked, validates failed refresh preserves valid snapshot. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures, not committed proprietary source datasets. No application code or repository files edited by this research agent.
